title: ContextGuardLockedIntentSchema
description: Defines the structured fields extracted and locked from the user's initial natural-language instruction. Immutable ground truth for the remainder of the task run.

origin.description: Departure city or airport code (e.g. Chennai, MAA)

destination.description: Arrival city or airport code (e.g. Delhi, DEL)

max_price.description: Optional maximum budget constraint in currency units
